dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear reduction in planar width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible structural deviations, bulges, or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density of faint, diffuse grey shading; no localized clusters of dark pixels or distinct mottling.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Highly diffuse gradient slopes between subtle grey tones and the primary white canvas.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, dark circular blowhole positioned on the anterior dorsal midline.
